set.reason: The square target expressly combines rectangle and rhombus properties; rectangle meaning and its right-angle/equal-diagonal properties are the appropriate content, rather than the general rectangle recognition repertoire. set.scope: The rectangle-property component inherited by a square and its inclusion in the rectangle class

set.scope: The rhombus-property component inherited by a square and its inclusion in the rhombus class
